title: Generic section factor of a supplied trait-divisor root chart
statement: Let S,C,c,sigma,G,Z,C_eta,q,j,seta,U,PA,jU,psi,s,a,L,N,n,tau and A0=O_(S,s) have the hypotheses and meanings specified here: S is integral normal Noetherian quasi-separated; c is quasi-compact quasi-separated smooth with geometrically connected fibres and section sigma; G is finite with invertible order; q,j describe the generic fibre and seta is its compatible generic section; Z is a finite etale G-torsor, PA its finite etale model over C_U with the compatible generic pullback squares; s is minimal outside U under specialization and A0 is a DVR; L=C times_S Spec A0, N is the pullback of the concrete normalization of PA\to C, n:N\to L is finite and tau its trait section [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-pc-fibre-product]. Choose x over tau(m_A0), a ring R, phi:Spec R\to L etale, y over n(x), rho:A0\to R, and varpi0 generating m_A0, such that phi composed with L\to Spec A0 equals Spec rho. Suppose an isomorphism over Spec R identifies N times_L Spec R with the spectrum of the product of R[T]/(T^(e_k)-rho(varpi0)), for positive e_k indexed by Fin m. For each k there exist a domain DVR A, its fraction field K, a uniformizer varpi with m_A=(varpi), its nonzero image pi in K as a unit, and b:Spec K\to Spec k(S), and an open immersion g:Spec K[T]/(T^(e_k)-pi)\to Z times_(C_eta) Spec K along seta b. Its composite with projection to Spec K is the canonical structural map.

proof.text: Use the pointed etale trait-lift lemma with hy followed by hx to obtain A, its injective trait map delta, the chart map iota, and the uniformizer delta(varpi0), with their commuting square.

Construct K=FractionRing A and pi=Units.mk0(algebraMap A K (delta varpi0)); irreducibility of a generator of the DVR maximal ideal and injectivity of the fraction-ring inclusion prove this image nonzero. Put theta=(algebraMap A K).comp iota. Its value on rho(varpi0) equals pi, and its scheme map followed by phi equals the generic trait map followed by tau.

Use the proved upstream generic normalization comparison, attached to the same dependency node, to obtain the ring map epsilon:k(S)->K and the comparison beta over Spec K. Set b=Spec epsilon; the extra equation extending delta is not needed by this parent. The product-chart base-change lemma supplies the kth open root factor. Rewrite its coefficient and base map using the established identities, compose its open immersion with beta.hom, and use both projection equalities to prove the displayed structural map identity. The parent statement, all three proof dependencies, and the unit route are unchanged.
